subject: Request: MentorHack organizer credits & extended trial for compute-heavy workshops
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@mentorhack.org>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 14:21:00 -0500
Subject: MentorHack — compute credits + extended trial?

Hi Avery / Monica,

Thanks again for the quick chat last week. MentorHack is running a two-day hands-on workshop series in SF (Nov 20–21) that pairs open-source maintainers with early-stage teams. We're planning three parallel tracks that will run GPU-backed demos and interactive model fine-tuning labs.

Quick ask: would Redwood be open to providing a combination of promo credits and a short trial extension so we can provision dedicated capacity for mentor stations (approx 8 mentor VMs concurrently) and offer attendees a seamless on-ramp?

What we need:
- 60,000 token-equivalent promo credits (to cover workshop usage and mentor demos)
- A 30-day trial extension for new signups that come from MentorHack (we expect ~120 signups)
- Permission to include Redwood as a sponsor in the event materials

Attached is a short scope doc and a CSV of participating mentors / orgs. We're happy to include a short booth demo and a 20-minute stage mention in exchange.

Budget sensitivity: the event is non-profit; our main currency is reach and maintainer goodwill. If you need us to route this through a partner sponsorship program or a small invoice, we can do that.

Appreciate any help — cc'ing Venue to coordinate logistics if we need on-site network configs.

Best,
Samira Khan
Partnerships, MentorHack Foundation

Attachments:
- mentorhack_scope.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)
- mentorship_roster.csv (CSV, 2 KB)

From: avery_johnson@redwood.com
To: Samira Khan <samira@mentorhack.org>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 15:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MentorHack — compute credits + extended trial?

Hi Samira — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the scope. Monica and I reviewed the materials quickly and this looks like a good fit for our community credits program. A few clarifying Qs before we loop legal/finance: 

1) For the "promo credits" line item, do you want a single pool that MentorHack distributes to attendees, or per-account credits for new signups?
2) Do any mentors need isolated/dedicated instances with persistent state for the two days (we can allocate persistent PVs, but that changes the cost profile)?
3) For the trial extension, do you want the extra 30 days applied to all new signups from MentorHack automatically, or do you prefer a claim code flow?

If you can reply with those 3 answers today, I can get a provisional sign-off from Sales Ops and loop Steph for a formal approval (and a draft sponsorship acknowledgement).

We'd also like the expected attendee breakdown by technical track (ML basics / fine-tuning / inference ops) so we can size the GPU types.

— Avery Johnson
Community Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com

> On Tue, Nov 2, 2027 at 2:21 PM Samira Khan <samira@mentorhack.org> wrote:

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@mentorhack.org>
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2027 09:11:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MentorHack — compute credits + extended trial?

Avery / Monica / Samira — thanks for the details. I'm OK to approve a provisional package with these constraints: 

- Promo credits: 60k token-equivalent issued as per-account redeemable credits for up to 120 attendees (max $750 worth per account)
- Trial extension: 30-day extension via single-use claim codes we will generate; valid for signups that use the MentorHack email domain or a claim code captured at registration.
- Dedicated mentor VMs: we'll cover persistent instances for up to 8 mentor workstations (NVIDIA A10 equivalent) for the two days. Requesting a small nominal chargeback to the event for persistent PVs if they exceed coverage.

Conditions: basic security checklist completed (SOC 2 attestation on file), and we need a single point of contact for post-event usage reporting. We'll issue credits under program code MK-2027-1129.

I've attached a short scope/terms stub that legal will need to sign off on — let's route that via DocuSign and include Samira on the agreement. Monica, can you prepare the claim-code bundle and the HubSpot campaign tracking so we can measure conversions?

Approved pending legal signature and final attendee list.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Strategic Programs (Sales Partnerships)
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Attachments:
- mentorhack_scope.pdf (updated v1.1)

> On Tue, Nov 2, 2027 at 3:03 PM avery_johnson@redwood.com wrote:
> [quoted reply omitted]

From: Samira Khan <samira@mentorhack.org>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, avery_johnson@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, venue@mentorhack.org
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2027 10:28:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MentorHack — compute credits + extended trial?

Amazing, thank you all — this is perfect.

Answers inline:  
- Promo credits: per-account redeemable credits is best (we want attendees to try Redwood beyond the event).
- Persistent instances: yes, 6 mentors will need persistent state (NFS volumes for datasets), 2 mentors will use ephemeral instances.
- Claim code flow for trial extension is preferred (easier for tracking).

We'll send the final attendee/mentor roster by EOD Friday and coordinate the DocuSign flow. I'll also add our sponsorship language for the website and stage mention.

One logistical note: our venue asked if Redwood can whitelist the workshop subnet for access — cc'ing venue to work with your infra contact.

I'll upload the roster CSV and a short venue network diagram to the HubSpot record (link above).

Thanks again — MentorHack team really appreciates the support and exposure for maintainers.

— Samira
Samira Khan
MentorHack Foundation
